source: dataSource mockup: the Plans tab (#pl, plans(), planPreview, kCodeHtml, drawPE, reviewModal) of plans/ledger-ui/design/mockup.html on dev, run headless with happy-dom (plans/ledger-ui/loop/tools/s0-text.mjs pattern) on its schools Vibes of Light, B4 Uni, Maple Pilates and Lotus Lane Yoga, and its smoke.mjs Plans and yaml checks. Shapes: src/data/plans.ts (buzz-school menu versions, brief A item 3, and the menu save and publish routes).
notes: Data: the mockup's schools (dataSource mockup). `fixtures` below is what the fixture Reader returns for S3 (src/data/plans.ts shapes; amounts in cents): the mockup's SC.<school>.pl as buzz-school Menu bodies, and the counts its headless run shows (planStats, attN, kpiSeries). Vibes of Light also has a saved, unpublished v4 (Glow $65.00 -> $70.00 a month), so its Plans tab opens with a draft as S0's tab badge already says; every mockup shot of it first runs the same change (mockupSteps). B4 Uni, Maple Pilates: v3 live, no draft. Lotus Lane Yoga: no version, Stripe not connected. Earlier published versions (v1, v2) are listed but never opened.

Routes: #/<school>/plans?mode=&show=&billing=. mode is edit (the default, no parameter), preview or code; show is live or draft (Preview; absent: draft when the draft has changes, else live); billing=year shows yearly prices (absent: monthly). Clicking plan-mode, plan-show or plan-billing navigates by hash; Preview sizes, the drawer, the review dialog and the toast are component state. root.dataset.route is set only once the Plans data of the route is on screen (the Plans pane reports itself, as the Dashboard does).

The UI keeps each school's draft for the life of the mount (switching school or tab and back shows the same draft) and never re-reads after a write. Writes are exactly those of src/data/plans.ts: saveMenu(schoolId, menu) with the whole draft menu whenever the draft changes and has no problems (drawer Save to draft, a Code edit once applied, Discard draft, Reset to published), publishMenu(schoolId) from the review. A draft with problems stays on screen unsaved. After publishMenu resolves the draft is the live version, its number plus one.

Code: plan-yaml is the textarea (its text is checked with the `value` expectation); plan-yaml-line is one gutter number per line of the text (`text.split('\n')`, so the final newline adds an empty last line), class bad on a line with a parse error or a problem. A fill (input event) may apply at once or after a debounce; pending text is applied before the Plans pane handles any click (a capture listener, as the mockup's kFlush on mousedown; the golden dispatches click only) and on blur. The status pill reads Valid, '<n> problem(s)' or 'Parse error at line <n>'. plan-yaml-message holds the error or problems, each with a jump button carrying data-line; 'No problems.' otherwise.

Changes are the mockup's diff() of the draft against the live menu, with its texts (New plan, Removed, 'Monthly price $a → $b', 'Yearly price', 'Sold in', 'What members get changed', 'Now on sale', 'Now hidden', 'Name "a" → "b"', 'Description changed'); plan-change and plan-publish-change carry data-plan; plan-change-badge is Removed or New. plan-draft-badge reads 'Draft · <n> change(s)' and the Plans tab badge (S0's tab-badge) shows 'draft' exactly when the draft has changes. Problems are the mockup's problems() texts; plan-problems (Edit and Preview) reads '<n> problem(s): <first>' plus ' (+<k> more)'.

Money: Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency }) of the menu currency from cents, as S1. Prices read as the mockup's priceTxt ('$32.50 per session / month · $350.00 / year'; a hidden tier with no price is 'Not for sale'; a pack '$40.00 one time' or '$x / month'); grants as grantTxt ('8 sessions per unit each month, rolls over 1 mo'; a pack charged once grants 'once'), with the feature's unit words. plan-monthly is the tier's PlanTierCount.monthlyMinor, the server's sum at the prices members bought (draft edits do not move it), '—' when null; plan-members is active, plan-ending '+<ending> ending' only when ending > 0. The strip (Edit only, only when the live menu has a tier): active members, 'Collected in <Mon>' from PlanSummary.collected, ending soon, need attention = the School's attentionCount; plan-stat carries data-stat active, collected, ending or attention; collected opens #/<school>/dashboard, the others the Members tab (S4).

Rows: plan-row carries data-plan (the id) and data-kind (tiers or addons), class chg when the draft changed it; plan-changed is its 'draft' badge, plan-hidden 'Hidden' for a non-public tier. plan-edit is the row's icon button (aria-label 'Edit <name>'); clicking the row or plan-edit opens the drawer. plan-count reads '<n> of 4' and '<n> of 6' (data-kind). plan-members (title 'Show these members') opens #/<school>/members?plan=<tierId>.

Drawer: plan-field carries data-field (name, blurb, public, month, year, quantities for a tier; name, price, every for a pack: a pack has no public flag in buzz-school's Menu); plan-grant-field carries data-field (amount, unit, every, rollover) and data-index. Fields react to input events, selects included. Monthly and yearly prices are typed in major units and saved as cents; sizes as '1, 2, 4'. A new plan's id is the mockup's slug of its name. plan-drawer-problem is one per problem; Save to draft is disabled while there is any. Escape closes the drawer.

Review: plan-publish-dialog opens from plan-review (enabled only with changes, no problems and Stripe connected; otherwise disabled with the mockup's title). plan-publish-summary counts the active members of the changed live tiers. An owner gets plan-publish-pin (Publish enabled from 4 digits); an admin gets plan-publish-lock and a disabled Publish titled 'Owners publish'. In hold mode, while publishMenu is pending, plan-publish-go reads 'Publishing…' and it and plan-publish-cancel are disabled. toast is S0's shell toast, hooked.

Audiences: route as=<owner|finance|admin|governance|member|public>; absent, the signed-in person's own (Kim R., owner, at Vibes of Light; Jo A., finance admin, at B4 Uni), as the mockup's View as (VW, vaAllowed: only roles and audiences at or below your own). Owner and finance see everything. Admin without the grant: the strip and the draft table, with collected, plan-members and plan-monthly as plan-hid data-hid=no_grant 'Finance or governance only'. Governance, member, public: no Get started and no strip; the table lists the LIVE tiers (governance: hidden ones too; below it: on sale only). Governance sees counts, a count of 1 to 4 as '<10' (plan-hid data-hid=approx, title 'Rounded to the nearest 10: fewer than 5 members') and Monthly under 5 payers as '—' (data-hid=suppressed, title 'Hidden: fewer than 5 payers'); member and public see 'Governance and up see this' (data-hid=no_grant). plan-books-note is the mockup's kplnote. Any preview (as= other than your own) disables every write control with title 'Exit preview to act' and makes the YAML read-only. The shell's View as control and banner are S0b's.

Audience: plan-audience is the row badge 'Audience: <name>' of a tier whose audience is not member (title 'The audience this plan names: what its members see of the school's books'); plan-field data-field=audience is the drawer's select (member 'Member (default)', governance, public) with plan-drawer-hint; the change line is 'Audience <a> → <b>' with the mockup's effect text; the YAML key is audience.
Not in S3: the Preview promo code (S5 Promos), Get started's Connect Stripe (Settings, S7) and Share your purchase link (no buzz-school source), Format and Copy results (clipboard).
`expect.moves` lists the `text` selectors of that expectation which the moving-data run checks again (protocol §7) through a Reader that multiplies `moves.fields`.
